data.title: Arthur Hayes: Trouble In France’s Bond Market Could Send Bitcoin To $250K
data.description: Arthur Hayes believes that problems in France's bond market could propel Bitcoin (BTC) to a new high. The BitMEX co-founder stated that a French debt crisis would push the Fed and U.S. Treasury to issue money.
